parsed_results.text: We did not retry failed payments; we retried failed notifications.
Unlike Lee et al. [4], we found no improvement in the smaller sample.
The deployment finally worked. My celebratory dance was mercifully undocumented.

parsed_results.note: The source gives no evidence for the claim that the scheduler was transformative, so it was removed.

parsed_results.text: The cache may reduce latency by about 10% when requests repeat. We have not tested cold starts.
The tapestry depicts a coastal landscape.
Please send the invoice by Friday.
The team launched the dashboard on Tuesday.
The prototype aims to detect duplicate invoices. We have not tested its accuracy. It could help the finance team.
The vector represents velocity. The robust regression estimates the slope while limiting the effect of outliers.
The migration is complete. "Ready to launch," the manager said. We still need to check the backups.

On Tuesday, I helped deploy the cache to two servers. In our 30-minute test, median latency for repeated requests fell from 80 ms to 60 ms. We have not tested cold starts or the other eight servers. The cache could reduce support tickets, but we have no evidence of that yet. The dashboard still shows yesterday's data.
parsed_results.note: The source has no evidence that the cache reduces support tickets, so the claim is kept as a possibility only. The dashboard issue is kept because it is a stated fact.
